title: Verify Parts Manager can reverse a Part Sales invoice
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Parts Manager role. (reversing a Part Sales invoice requires Part Sales: Delete per spec v33; this role has it).
At least one Part Sales invoice exists under Part Sales.
steps:
1. Click Part Sales and open an existing invoice.
2. Click Reverse and confirm.
expected: The Part Sales invoice is reversed successfully.
